pages.quiz:
ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. run
   D. blue

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. One main idea with supporting sentences
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

3. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.

4. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library
   D. Where is the Library

5. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.

6. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.

7. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. A person, place, thing, or idea
   B. Only an action
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

8. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.

9. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. goes
   D. going

10. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

11. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.

12. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — run

2. B — One main idea with supporting sentences

3. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.

4. A — Where is the library?

5. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.

7. A — A person, place, thing, or idea

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

9. A — went

10. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.

11. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Spelling; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Punctuation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Guided Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Attentive Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
